description: Deletes one Clio calendar entry by its event_id. Refuses repeating entries (that would delete the series). A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

event_id.description: The event_id from list_calendar_events or list_matter_calendar_events.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

name: delete_calendar_event
title: Delete Clio calendar entry
